# The data-collection policy controls the visibility of the Privacy settings section

DisableDataCollectionSettings calls the shared locking helper with the separate mail.data_collection_settings.enabled preference set false. Privacy initialization then hides both the category and group with display:none !important and skips reporting-control setup; pane search can otherwise reset hidden. The browser test directly sets the pref and asserts both nodes hidden, while separate policy-test data checks the pref value and lock state. This does not establish policy-to-render execution or a change to telemetry consent or submission behavior.

Scope: Enterprise policies and Privacy preferences visibility.
